requirements.rule: LEAVE, PAR (Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 5, renewal of 22 November 2025 p. 33): the settore siderurgico (EmployerProfile.subsector steel) accrues 124 hours in place of 104, every other firm (subsector general) 104, and the turnisti on 15 or more weekly shifts including the night shift (Employment.qualifying_shifts) 8 hours more. The further 4 hours from 2027 at 18 or more weekly shifts and 4 more from 2028 at 21 for the non siderurgico workers are permit extra_hours on Employment.weekly_shifts. The hour of the sottosettori of the accordo of 16 July 1979 (8 hours a year) goes to the workers holding the role sottosettore_1979 hired by 31 December 2012. Not modelled: the 8 hours of the siderurgico turnisti, paid with the 13th.
requirements.remediation: Pay the 8 hours of the siderurgico turnisti with the 13th, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: MULTI-WEEK SCHEDULE: the premiums of the orario plurisettimanale of Art. 5 as renewed on 22 November 2025 are the bands OT_PLURI (15%), OT_PLURI_SABATO (25%) and, for sudden needs, OT_PLURI_IMPROVVISO (20%) and OT_PLURI_IMPROVVISO_SABATO (30%), premium only. Not modelled: their rise 'a partire dalla 81esima ora' ('elevate nella misura onnicomprensiva dell'8%'), which needs the hours of the schedule worked in the year. The night-holiday work of Art. 7 rows h) and i) is paid by the FED_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO* supplement bands, the shift column of the overtime by OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI, OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI_EXTRA and OT_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO_TURNI for an event with in_periodic_shift.
requirements.remediation: Add the hours of the multi-week schedule worked in the year to pay the 8% from the 81st hour, then resolve this limitation.
